title: Bots, bots, bots, bots, bots TBC and bots

posts.cooked:
Can us players get a blue post in response to all the botting being allowed to happen in-game.
We have bots, farming every single mat in TBC,
we have players using AI botting for summons and portals.
We have bots selling PVP rating in trade chats.
We have bots in pvp.
We have bots selling dungeon loot and raid loot.
We have bots farming rares.
Can the players get a blue post on what is being done to stop all the bots in the game? @[Kaivax](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/kaivax)
Hey they banned the casinos. Now you want them to do more work?!?! Shouldn’t you be happy with what they give you?
Kinda enjoying all the people who now realize the bots are the problem. Not the people who are having some fun gambling in SW. Lol
Well, they would, but the people running the game, and the forums are unfortunately BOTS.

Kinda enjoying all the people who now realize the bots are the problem. Not the people who are having some fun gambling in SW. Lol
Well yes, but imagine being a Blizzard California DEI hire with blue hair and a septum nose ring, what is easier to do: go after some guy openly gambling in the same spot, or trying to find very obvious bots and get them?
Bro, they don’t even have the libs working there anymore, it’s 100% automated. That’s why skynet keeps dropping patches on us and forkin up our addons.
Oh I refuse to believe that a California company does not have a few purple-haired land whales employed, spending 90% of their paid time on Bluesky, screaming about DRUMPF or Elon Musk.
They might have some Harris voters mopping the floors, or keeping the wires to skynet clean.

What are they going to do with their pointless lives when those big bad men eventually leave the political scene anyway?
What an empty existence.

Hey they banned the casinos.
There’s still casino bots standing in stormwind 24/7
they showed back up within an hour of the servers coming online today
I’d argue that a truly empty existence is worshiping everything the orange clown says and insisting that everything negative about him is “fake news”

they showed back up within an hour of the servers coming online today
What server? Haven’t seen one on nightslayer alliance in almost a week now. But in all honesty, blizz needs to get its priorities straight. The casinos are not affecting the economy at all. Ban the bots that have crushed another version of wow into the dirt again ffs. No one cares about the people gambling. Thats light work compared to the real problem.

Once they figure this out it will inevitably be too late. They do this thing at blizzard where they act like they can’t see the bots and are helpless to combat them in anyway. But they can sure ban the dudes trading 50g between themselves in SW. The easy target is not always the right target. Go find the real problem and stop being lazy blizzard. You are killing your game.

we also have players buying the mats/gold from the bots/farmers.
supply and demand.
Who’s the problem here?

Worship?
Nobody is building shrines to the dude. You’re spouting absolute nonsense.
A lot of folks are going to be completely empty when he leaves, or, delude themselves even more with yet another target for their insanity.

obviously the bots are the problem dude. With no bots the price of RMT gold will be too high for most people to consider buying. We don’t have a RMT problem, we have a botting problem.
No game benefits from botters having infinite gold to sell. Wow is no exception. It’s been the main reason I and many others have stopped playing in the past. It’s just not fun when the economy has been, and continues to be, ravaged by bots.
When every gold making avenue is being actively exploited by bots. It makes farming not plausible for the average player. Then there is no other option than to buy what they are selling.

Blizzard will never ban the botters, they’re subs, it’s money to them, if they really cared about the bots, they’d have dealt with the mana thistle/mining bots ages ago.
Don’t forget players getting banned because bots are mass reporting players unlucky enough to get in their way.

We don’t have a RMT problem
If people didn’t buy gold, Bots wouldn’t farm the gold.
we have a botting problem
Because we have a RMT problem.
